title: Large outdoor wood/downs areas (Ashwood near the Vale, the Iron Downs approach to Cinderhall) have many similarly-described rooms (spoil, tailings, cairns) with directional exits that don't obviously connect back to the intended route, so it's easy to wander a few extra rooms before 'get your bearings' clarifies the path.
